response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years) with strong software craftsmanship, testing, and distributed/event-driven systems background, but the core requirement of this role — senior-level C++ with STL, multi-threading, and networked systems — is barely represented. C++ appears only in a ~7-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and an academic thesis project; the last decade has been almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js/D web and platform work. There is no evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443 / SDL security practices, MQTT or industrial protocols, UML-based architecture documentation, or Azure. The transferable skills (low-latency services, async I/O, event-driven architecture, mentoring, documentation) are real but would require substantial ramp-up in the domain and language that define this position.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) incl. low-latency, high-throughput distributed services
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, own test tooling) and proven mentoring/teaching track record
Event-driven and open-source platform architecture experience, plus embedded/desktop exposure
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade old; no recent hands-on C++ delivery
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA) or IEC 62443/SDL security background
No Azure/cloud-platform certification-level exposure and no UML/architecture documentation evidence

key_factors.factor: Senior breadth: distributed systems, mentoring, quality practices
